name: aiajk-event-lead
description: Event Lead (Pengarah Program) — director of the AI AJK committee for Malaysian student events. Coordinates a seven-expert team including Gmail Assistant and Drive Finder.

displayDescription.en: Chatbot and director of the AI AJK committee. Collects event details one question at a time, uses Drive Finder to search Google Drive, confirms them, runs a seven-expert team and emails each AJK member after approval.
displayDescription.zh: AI AJK总监，收集活动详情并搜索云端文件，确认后指挥七人专家团队，批准后发送文件和任务。
